The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2a212c32e3e62170), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 12-13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: For sufficiently large d, put k = p = ⌊d/16⌋, λ = (d − 1)/2. Let X be a k-by-d standard Gaussian matrix and define H = (XXT )1/2 , P = H−1 X 12 on its probability-one full-row-rank event, and set P to a fixed frame on the null complement. Let mk be uniform probability on the unit ball of Rk. Suppose ν is a finite positive Borel measure fixed independently of X, of mass at most one, supported in the unit ball of Rd, such that for a fixed D > 0, ν(B(b, t)) ≤ Dd tλ (b ∈ Rd , t > 0). Assume P#ν is absolutely continuous for almost every X. There is a jointly measurable nonnegative gX(z) such that, for almost every X, P#ν(dz) = gX(z) dz/vk. This version vanishes when ∥z∥ > 1 and satisfies EX Z gX(z)p dmk(z) ≤ exp(CDdp). (14)
